name: Radiant Tale ~Fanfare!~
original_name: ラディアンテイル ～ファンファーレ！～
source:
Fan disk of Radiant Tale.

After Story:
After stories set after happy end of the first route for all LI.

At the end of a journey filled with tears, laughter, and the company of your comrades, what you find, is...

If Story:
Jinnia and Liyan route set after normal end of the first game.

"Be my secretary!"

Interlude:
Short stories set in the timeline of the common route in the first game.
